findings.detail: Both reason and capture_text copy text without modifying it. Using three names for the same logical line adds bookkeeping and suggests transformations that do not occur.
findings.fix: Match both regexes against text directly, remove the two assignments, and reduce the signature to check_output(text, file). Preserve the regexes, check order and exemption comments.
findings.title: write-bash-scripts: Naming: Remove redundant aliases of the logical line.

strengths: Discard and capture checks have explicit precedence.
Static samples make acceptance and rejection cases easy to trace.
summary: Reviewed the full committed scope and found one worthwhile simplification in the new guard. No files or Git state were changed, as required by the report-only override.
